fields.title: 3. Proposal for new rules — none
fields.md:
This case is not an input to the existing proposals ①–⑤, and the profit-and-loss path is not specific enough to establish a new rule (SpaceX is not a defendant). However, a **design gap** is noted: Axis E carries 'Musk risk' in name only and has no milestone — over the month of October, Musk's return to the Department of Defense advisory committee, the conflict-of-interest controversy and the lawsuit all passed outside any milestone. Whether to set a milestone such as 'zero events in which Musk's government role attaches conditions to SpaceX contracts through an official determination (a court FACA ruling, an OGE/Department of Defense ethics determination, or a congressional hearing)' will be decided by the monthly round (12/01) — event rounds cover increments only (source: `state.rule_proposals_not_applied` · `state.axes` · Section 1-1).
